# Personality

  

Trait 1: 

She wishes to see many perspectives before choosing the best option for everyone.

  

Trait 2: 

She likes to do things by the books, but she has no problem switching to a more devious tactic if that works to her advantage or her vision.

  

Ideals: 

She believes in a very Machiavellian pragmatism.

  

Bonds:

She wishes to cultivate the power deep within like her mentor told her.

  

Flaws:

She has a competitive and devious other side that she likes to hide away behind a mask of innocence. 

# Backstory

The Laowei bloodline is a minor noble house in the trade kingdom of [Tegvora](Tegvora). These serpentfolk have settled there quite recently as foreign trade partners and they used their strong economic prowess to carve themselves a place as nobles in the kingdom. Born into this family was Xuê, the third sister of the future house leader. She would never enjoy the life of a rich merchant noble like her older sisters. She was promptly sent to other noble houses to learn the fine traits of bureaucracy and management. 

She was assigned a mentor, the Honourable Lady Nagi, a [yuan-ti](yuan-ti) with a huge black and green tail. With her, she learned the fine ploys of the game of politics in the lower noble houses. Alongside this she learned quickly how to improve a state and to find loopholes in existing systems. [Xuě](Laowai%20Xhê.md) was rising through the ranks of the merchant kingdom and Lady Nagi found that inside the girl was a great untapped potential.

The 10-year-old Xuě, who at this point earned the name of Lady Lao, the young governess, suddenly found no quill and books at her training desk but a simple sword.

With combat training alongside the usual paperwork, her days became long and nights short. She barely got time to breathe before her mentor demanded her to pick up the pen or sword. 

After she turned 15 she would be assigned on her first official mission for the kingdom as she was to be part of a diplomatic retinue through [Caelycion](Caelycion). On her way there the caravan was ambushed by orc and raiders. Her mentor sacrificed herself so that [Lao](Lao) would be able to hide. Her last words were that she should harness the inner dragon inside of her. 

She hid under the broken frame of one of the carriages as the guards attempted to hold the attackers back. Closing her eyes and keeping her hands over her ears refusing to see reality as it is. As soon as she opened her eyes she was confronted by the sniffing nose of a [warg](warg) who’d growl loudly as an Orc scavenger approached her. The small girl feared for her life and started to scream in [abyssal](abyssal). The frenzied orcs, coated in the blood of the guards, would approach her, craving the kill. She would have been lost if she was not saved that day by a mysterious fighter called [Silas Edwards](Silas%20Edwards). Silas would have been in the area when the caravan got attacked however be to late to save the majority of the convoy. Only able to save the screaming girl. After dealing with the Orcs he would take the 15-year-old [Yuan ti](knowledge%20books/Taxonomical%20diffrences%20between%20diffrent%20humanoid%20races/Yuan%20ti.md) with him to [Halycion](Haven.md) after confirming that all other members of the caravan had been killed in the fight.  Silas recognised her colours as part of a noble house and took her in. Making preparations to arrange a caravan back east. She quickly adapted to life at [Halycion](Haven.md) and due to her status and education, alongside her ability to speak 4 languages, managed to earn herself a position in the city's administration with a strong future to gather money to finance the trip home. 

She got into the city just in time as the shift would happen several weeks later. This great show of magical strength intimidated the young girl who would spend her days at her new adoptive father’s side, slightly cowering of the event and the arcane influences. The shift imprinted a great dislike for the arcane for she was it as a means to sever all the possibilities of her returning home. She wouldn’t leave the old adventurer’s side for weeks however continues to distrust magic until the very day.

[Silas](Silas) who due to his ex-life as a strong and well-desired adventure could afford her a luxurious lifestyle if she wanted to make up for his inability to send her home safely. However, he noticed that although she was happy with the gifts and luxury she did not feel satisfied with it. He encouraged the young lady to return to something she is good in, instead of continuing working as a clerk in city hall she would switch to work in [the Guild](Striders guild). Her work progressed nicely as she was fairly talented in writing and reading, and able to keep up with piles of work. She was quickly promoted to chief writer and was in charge of writing the many different quests and guild notices by orders of her bosses at the top. As she grew older she understood more and more about the world and got a taste of power and luxury, her father being a retired veteran could afford her a lavish lifestyle and her own salary wasn’t so bad either. She often found herself torn between who she was as a spoiled daughter of a rich family that no longer existed, a dedicated trainee and a cog in the grand administrative machine taught by a master who is long since missing, or a pragmatic spirit who navigates her way safely through the dark and corrupt ways of the world.

Eventually, at 26 she reportedly fought with her boss, some days afterwards she got the notice that she would be required to accompany the many adventurers to ensure that they keep up with the guild code of conduct.

# Questions

  

- Why is your character adventuring?
      
Seeing that some guild members have been taking actions that go against the law (such as cannibalism), and to little knowledge of what actually goes down in the missions. The guild overseers decided to send one of their own to keep an eye out. She is very much adventuring against her will (at first). However it will be her duty and she will admit to her boss that she cannot handle it.

  

- *What motivates your character into danger? (tip: think of an event in their life that influences what satisfies them)
    
Her mentor’s last words and training urge her to always try her best to do more and more. To keep improving and stand her ground.

  

- *What is your character’s personal goal? What would they like to achieve in their lifetime?
    

There is a feeling of elemental power deep within her according to her mentor. To her, it feels like flashes of cold fire and more as a decease but in time it will develop into a powerful gift. This will be a driving power to come to the powers of her subclass as an ascended dragon. Aside from this, she is unsure, she does not know who she is and what she will become.

  

- What sort of place did your character grow up in? What kinds of areas are they familiar with? 
    
She grew up in the marine trade kingdom of Tegvora. She understands both the intriguing landscape of politics and the swamps, rivers, and narrow seas of her homeland. 

  

- *Why is your character their current class? Why do they have their current skill set?
    


She is a monk, while not explicitly trained in combat using strength but using the enemy's own skills against them and her snakelike movement to have an advantage in hand-to-hand combat and in a style that is akin to medieval Chinese sword dueling.

  

-  What person/place/thing is your character attached to? 
    

She is currently in the care of a noble veteran named Silas. While he is often viewed as opportunistic for adopting a child of foreign nobility in the hopes of strengthening his ties, in truth Lao sees him as a father she never had. Trusting him and his wisdom.

  

- What or who is your character knowledgeable about?
    
She knows how to do her work as an administrator in both big and small regions. Knowing the intrigues of the political playset and drama. She knows how to write and calculate to an almost unseen degree.

  

- Does your character have secrets? What will come as a shock to fellow players? 
    
She has traits she earned from her own family, sometimes showing behaviour keen to that of cunning and devious nobles. However, she likes to keep those at bay and play as an innocent and kind young lady. 

  

- What sort of special relationships does your character have? Do they have friends and enemies? What about their family?
    
Apart from her adoptive father, she only had her mentor back then. Now that she is gone she fills the void by talking to her father and her friends at the guild.

  

- What is your character's alignment? 
    
Neutral good
